cards.back: An angle is its opening, not its arms. Unequal arm lengths distort the comparison. Picture both arms trimmed to the same length from the vertex and compare the gap between the tips.
Find the clearly smallest and clearly largest first and eliminate options that disagree. Compare the remaining middle pair against 90 or 180 degrees as an anchor, then commit.
